
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/edisontalk/p/-/quick-start-on-maf-chatper24" title="发布于 2026-04-20 09:42">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">MAF快速入门（24）整合多个Skill来源</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202604/381412-20260419215302083-416233815.png" alt="MAF快速入门（24）整合多个Skill来源" class="desc_img">
        本文介绍了MAF如何整合多个Agent Skill Source实现企业级Skill管控 和 角色Skill可见性控制，这在企业级应用中是非常实用的特性和实践。不过，目前MAF的Agent Skills仍然属于实验性支持阶段，生产落地还需谨慎。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span><span>大家好，我是Edison。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>最近我一直在跟着圣杰的《<span>.NET+AI智能体开发进阶<span>》课程学习MAF开发智能体应用，我强烈推荐你也上车跟我一起出发！</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>MAF 1.1.0 对 Agent Skill 的补全绝对是工程化的典范，今天我们来看看如何整合多个Skill来源实现企业级多技能控制。</span></span></p>
<h1><strong>1 企业级需求：多个Skill来源管控</strong></h1>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span>在写Agent Skill的时候，我就在想企业级应用中应该需要一个Skill管控，维护一些中央可复用Skill推送到各个员工的Agent中，而各个员工也会自己写一些自己任务的Skill 或者 重写远程Skill来覆盖实现自己的任务<span>。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>这种多级Skill来源的控制设计已经在MAF中被考虑进来了，我们可以通过自定义AgentSkillsSource来实现，这意味着我们可以从任何地方为Agent提供Skill，包括但不限于：HTTP API、数据库、配置中心等等。</span></span></p>
<h1><strong><span>2 快速开始：整合多个来源Skill<strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;6 3 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);outline: 0px;visibility: visible;line-height: 1.75em;margin-top: 16px;margin-bottom: 16px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;color: rgb(0, 179, 139);font-family: \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Lantinghei SC\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft Yahei\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft Sans Serif\&quot;, \&quot;WenQuanYi Micro Hei\&quot;, Helvetica, sans-serif;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.544px;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><br></span></strong></span></strong></h1>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []">这里我们来做一个企业HR<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;clear: both;min-height: 1em;color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);font-family: \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.578px;orphans: 2;text-align: left;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;white-space: normal;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;line-height: 1.75em;visibility: visible;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin: 0px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;visibility: visible;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">助手</span>，整合以下多个来源的Skill并实现角色管控Skill可见。</p>
<ol class="list-paddingleft-1" start="1">
<li>
<p><span><span>全局技能库<span>（假设通过Remote HTTP API来获取）：它是所有员工通用的政策和流程；</span></span></span></p>





</li>
<li>
<p><span><span>本地技能库<span>（假设通过InMemory来获取）：它是各个员工自己定制的任务技能</span></span></span></p>





</li>
<li>
<p><span><span>用户角色技能<span>（假设通过自定义Source来获取）：根据当前用户角色做动态过滤</span></span></span></p>





</li>





</ol>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>在这个案例中，我们想要实现只有 全局通用技能 + 角色专属技能 对Agent可见，且本地的同名称技能可以覆盖远程的全局技能。</span></span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>本文案例使用的模型为：<span>Qwen3.5-35B-A3B</span></span></span></p>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>准备工作</span></span></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>在开始之前，我们创建了一个控制台应用，并安装了以下NuGet包：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>&lt;PackageReference Include=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Microsoft.Agents.AI.OpenAI</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> Version=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1.1.0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /&gt;</pre>
</div>
<p>假设我们的企业员工角色定义有三种：员工、经理 和 HR管理员</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">enum</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EmployeeRole
{
    Employee,
    Manager,
    HRAdmin
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">为了方便实现Skill的角色过滤，我们实现一个方法来判断：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserRoleHelper
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IsSkillVisibleTo(AgentSkill skill, EmployeeRole role)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> name =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> skill.Frontmatter.Name;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 管理技能仅经理和HR可见</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (name.StartsWith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">manager-</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) &amp;&amp; role ==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EmployeeRole.Employee) 
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> HR管理技能仅HR可见</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (name.StartsWith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hr-admin-</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) &amp;&amp; role !=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> EmployeeRole.HRAdmin) 
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">可以看到，我们这里针对管理技能仅能经理和HR可见，而HR相关技能则仅能HR可见。</span></p>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><strong><strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>实现远程SkillSource</span></span></strong></strong></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>这里我们定义一个企业的远程SkillSource，模拟从远程API拉取统一定义的技能。</span></span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>在实际项目中，通常会使用HttpClient来访问一个注册中心来实现。</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SimulatedRemoteApiSkillsSource : AgentSkillsSource
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _apiEndpoint;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> SimulatedRemoteApiSkillsSource(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> apiEndpoint)
    {
        _apiEndpoint </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> apiEndpoint;
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;IList&lt;AgentSkill&gt;&gt; GetSkillsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">📡 [RemoteApiSource] 从 {_apiEndpoint} 拉取技能列表...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> Task.Delay(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">500</span>, cancellationToken); <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟网络延迟</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entries =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GetMockGlobalSkills();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> skills = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;AgentSkill&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> entry <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> entries)
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> skill = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AgentInlineSkill(entry.Name, entry.Description, entry.Instructions);
                skills.Add(skill);
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (ArgumentException ex)
            {
                Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">⚠️ [RemoteApiSource] 跳过非法技能 '{entry.Name}': {ex.Message[..Math.Min(60, ex.Message.Length)]}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            }
        }
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ [RemoteApiSource] 已成功加载 {skills.Count} 个远程技能</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> skills;
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> IList&lt;SkillApiEntry&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> GetMockGlobalSkills()
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;SkillApiEntry&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">expense-report</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">（全局v1）企业费用报销政策</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">全局版报销规则：...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hr-onboarding</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,   <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">（全局）新员工入职流程</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,         <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">入职材料清单：...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">leave-policy</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">（全局）请假制度和申请流程</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,      <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">年假/病假/事假规则：...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">manager-review</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">（全局）绩效评估指南</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,           <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">季度评估流程：...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">hr-admin-audit</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">（全局）HR 审计和合规</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,          <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">合规审查清单：...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
        };
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin-top: 0px;margin-bottom: 0px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">这里SkillApiEntry模型的定义如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> record SkillApiEntry(
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Name, 
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Description, 
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Instructions, 
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>[]? Tags = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>);</pre>
</div>
<h3 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><strong><strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin-top: 0px;margin-bottom: 0px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>实现远程Skills的缓存化</span></span></strong></strong></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;-webkit-tap-highlight-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0);margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;clear: both;min-height: 1em;color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9);font-family: \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.578px;orphans: 2;text-align: left;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;white-space: normal;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;line-height: 1.75em;visibility: visible;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>远程Skills具有时效性，需要定期更新来同步，因此弄一个带TTL（Time-To-Live）缓存的装饰器，它可以强制Agent客户端定期刷新远程Skills来保持同步。</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CachingSkillsSource : AgentSkillsSource
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AgentSkillsSource _innerSource;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TimeSpan _ttl;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> IList&lt;AgentSkill&gt;?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _cache;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> DateTime _cacheExpiresAt =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DateTime.MinValue;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span> SemaphoreSlim _lock = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CachingSkillsSource(AgentSkillsSource innerSource, TimeSpan ttl)
    {
        _innerSource </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> innerSource;
        _ttl </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ttl;
    }
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;IList&lt;AgentSkill&gt;&gt; GetSkillsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_cache != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> &amp;&amp; DateTime.UtcNow &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _cacheExpiresAt)
        {
            Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">⚡ [CachingSource] 命中缓存（过期时间: {_cacheExpiresAt.ToLocalTime():HH:mm:ss}）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _cache;
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _lock.WaitAsync(cancellationToken);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 双重检查锁（避免并发刷新）</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_cache != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> &amp;&amp; DateTime.UtcNow &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _cacheExpiresAt)
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _cache;
            Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🔄 [CachingSource] 缓存未命中，从内层 Source 刷新...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            _cache </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _innerSource.GetSkillsAsync(cancellationToken);
            _cacheExpiresAt </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DateTime.UtcNow.Add(_ttl);
            Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ [CachingSource] 缓存已更新，{_cache.Count} 个技能，有效至 {_cacheExpiresAt.ToLocalTime():HH:mm:ss}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _cache;
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">finally</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            _lock.Release();
        }
    }
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> InvalidateCache() { _cache = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>; _cacheExpiresAt =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DateTime.MinValue; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">bool</span> IsCacheValid =&gt; _cache != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> &amp;&amp; DateTime.UtcNow &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _cacheExpiresAt;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 data-pm-slice="4 2 []"><strong><strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>实现本地Skills</span></span></strong></strong></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>这里我们定义一些本地Skills，通过Inline Skill的方式增加一个本地任务技能 和 覆盖一个同名的远程仅能。</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SimulatedLocalApiSkillsFactory
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> Task&lt;IList&lt;AgentInlineSkill&gt;&gt; GetSkillsAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">default</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">🏠 [LocalApiFactory] 正在从本地获取技能列表...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> localSkills = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;AgentInlineSkill&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 覆盖全局 expense-report，使用 Contoso 定制规则</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> AgentInlineSkill(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">expense-report</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">（Contoso定制v2）企业费用报销政策</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                # Contoso 定制报销规则（2025版）
                </span>- 差旅费上限提升至 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8000</span> 元/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">次
                </span>- 新增<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">远程协作设备补贴</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">类目，≤3000元免审批
                </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 年末报销截止日期：12月25日
                </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">),</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 新增：Contoso 特有的技能</span>
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> AgentInlineSkill(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">contoso-benefits</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Contoso 员工福利计划详情</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">福利：弹性办公、年度体检、学习补贴...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">),
        };
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">✅ [LocalApiFactory] 已成功加载 {localSkills.Count} 个本地技能</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> localSkills;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 data-pm-slice="4 2 []"><strong><strong><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;letter-spacing: 0.578px;text-align: left;margin: 8px;&quot;,&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;strong&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>Agent客户端加载Skills</span></span></strong></strong></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>这里我们在Agent客户端加载本地 和 远程技能，同时对远程技能做1小时的缓存代理。</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ── Source 1：本地定制技能（覆盖全局版，注册顺序靠前 → 优先）──</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> localCustomSkills = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> SimulatedLocalApiSkillsFactory.GetSkillsAsync();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ── Source 2：模拟全局技能库（Remote API，通用政策）──</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> globalSource = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> SimulatedRemoteApiSkillsSource(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">https://global-skills.contoso.com/api</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ── Source 3：带缓存的远程 Source（生产环境推荐）──</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> cachedGlobalSource = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> CachingSkillsSource(globalSource, TimeSpan.FromMinutes(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">60</span>));</pre>
</div>
<h3 data-pm-slice="4 2 []"><span><span>构建针对角色的SkillsProvider工厂</span></span></h3>
<p data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>这里我们用MAF提供的Builder模式来实现一个面向指定角色的SkillsProvider工厂方法：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">AgentSkillsProvider BuildProviderForRole(EmployeeRole role)
{
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n🔨 开始构建 {role} 角色的 Provider...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AgentSkillsProviderBuilder()
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 本地定制优先（先注册 → first-wins）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        .UseSkills(localCustomSkills)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 全局技能库（带缓存）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        .UseSource(cachedGlobalSource)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 角色感知过滤</span>
        .UseFilter(s =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> UserRoleHelper.IsSkillVisibleTo(s, role))
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自定义 Prompt：企业内部语气</span>
        .UsePromptTemplate(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            你是 Contoso 集团的企业服务助手。
            ## 你掌握的企业知识库
            {skills}
            ## 工作原则
            遇到政策性问题，</span>**先加载该技能的详细指引**<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">，再作答。请确保所有建议符合 Contoso 最新官方规定。
            {resource_instructions}
            {script_instructions}
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"""</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">)</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        .Build();
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 data-pm-slice="3 3 []"><strong><span><span>测试验证各个角色的技能可见范围</span></span></strong></h3>
<p>这里通过下面的测试代码来创建三个角色使用的SkllsProvider，通过获取其Skills可见范围来进行验证：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 验证三个角色看到的技能集合</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> role <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> Enum.GetValues&lt;EmployeeRole&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">())
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> provider =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BuildProviderForRole(role);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> srcField = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span>(AgentSkillsProvider).GetField(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">_source</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, BindingFlags.Instance |<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BindingFlags.NonPublic);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> src = (AgentSkillsSource?)srcField?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.GetValue(provider);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> skills = src <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> ? 
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;AgentSkill&gt;() : (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> src.GetSkillsAsync()).ToList();
    Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\n━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">👤 [{role}] 可见技能（{skills.Count} 个）：</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> s <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> skills)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> origin = s.Frontmatter.Description.StartsWith(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">（Contoso</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) ? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">（本地定制）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> :
                        s.Frontmatter.Description.StartsWith(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">（全局</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>) ? <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">（全局库）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> : <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">（其他）</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">    • {s.Frontmatter.Name} {origin}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>测试结果如下图所示：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/381412/202604/381412-20260419214931293-1521140145.png" alt="image" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<h1><strong><span>3 小结</span></strong></h1>
<p>本文介绍了MAF如何整合多个Agent Skill Source实现企业级Skill管控 和 角色Skill可见性控制，这在企业级应用中是非常实用的特性和实践。不过，目前MAF的Agent Skills仍然属于实验性支持阶段，生产落地还需谨慎。</p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;margin: 8px;padding: 0px;outline: 0px;max-width: 100%;color: rgb(34, 34, 34);font-size: 17px;font-style: normal;font-variant-ligatures: normal;font-variant-caps: normal;font-weight: 400;letter-spacing: 0.544px;orphans: 2;text-indent: 0px;text-transform: none;white-space: normal;widows: 2;word-spacing: 0px;-webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px;background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255);text-decoration-thickness: initial;text-decoration-style: initial;text-decoration-color: initial;font-family: -apple-system-font, BlinkMacSystemFont, \&quot;Helvetica Neue\&quot;, \&quot;PingFang SC\&quot;, \&quot;Hiragino Sans GB\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei UI\&quot;, \&quot;Microsoft YaHei\&quot;, Arial, sans-serif;min-height: 1em;text-align: left;visibility: visible;box-sizing: border-box !important;overflow-wrap: break-word !important;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;node&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;span&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;0 0 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">不过，目前MAF的Agent Skills仍然属于实验性支持阶段，生产落地还需谨慎。</span></span></p>
